category_title: Quietly on-task students who struggle with independent inquiry and rely on peer cues
minimal_context: The student is participating in a whole-class informal check for understanding about living and nonliving items from a courtyard ecology exploration.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Class, we just finished looking at the living and nonliving items from our courtyard ecology exploration.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please give a thumbs-up or wiggle your finger to show that you understand.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Does not wiggle their finger, keeping their hands still.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I need everyone to show me their hand signal so I know if we can move on.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows a thumbs-down to indicate a lack of knowledge and uncertainty, remaining completely silent.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Class, we just finished looking at the living and nonliving items from our courtyard ecology exploration.

STUDENT: (Sits quietly during the whole-class instruction.)

TUTOR: Please give a thumbs-up or wiggle your finger to show that you understand.

STUDENT: (Does not wiggle their finger, keeping their hands still.)

TUTOR: I need everyone to show me their hand signal so I know if we can move on.

STUDENT: (Shows a thumbs-down to indicate a lack of knowledge and uncertainty, remaining completely silent.)

task.content: Participating in informal checks for understanding during whole-class instruction

context.materials: Courtyard ecology exploration items (living and nonliving), quiz

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When teachers asked students to give a thumbs-up or wiggle their finger to show they understand
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Showed thumbs-down or did not wiggle their finger to indicate their lack of knowledge
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Communicated uncertainty and lack of knowledge

behavior_patterns.condition: When teachers gave the direction for informal checks
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Indicated their lack of knowledge during informal checks
